name: potgrowhubstore
description: The AI-Powered Cannabis Ecosystem, Botanical Intelligence, 3D/AR Visualization & PWA E-Commerce Suite

scripts.build: echo 'Building static PWA bundle...' && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html style.css script.js manifest.json service-worker.js robots.txt sitemap.xml ads.txt seo.txt aeo.txt security.txt dist/
scripts.postbuild: echo 'PWA bundle successfully built and verified.'
scripts.validate:syntax: node --check script.js && node --check service-worker.js && node --check server.js
scripts.validate:files: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const files=['index.html','style.css','script.js','manifest.json','service-worker.js','robots.txt','sitemap.xml','ads.txt','seo.txt','aeo.txt','security.txt']; const missing=files.filter(file=>!fs.existsSync(file)); if(missing.length) throw new Error('Missing files: '+missing.join(', '));"
scripts.validate:package: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); for(const key of ['name','version','scripts','dependencies']) if(!p[key]) throw new Error('Missing package field: '+key);"
scripts.validate:config: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const c=p.config; if(!c||!Number.isInteger(c.port)||c.port<1||c.port>65535) throw new Error('Invalid configured port'); if(!['development','test','staging','production'].includes(c.environment)) throw new Error('Invalid configured environment');"
scripts.validate:exports: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const p=require('./package.json'); const visit=value=>{if(typeof value==='string'&&value.startsWith('./')&&!value.includes('*')&&!fs.existsSync(value)) throw new Error('Missing export target: '+value); if(value&&typeof value==='object') Object.values(value).forEach(visit);}; visit(p.exports); for(const key of ['main','module','types','typings']) if(p[key]&&!fs.existsSync(p[key])) throw new Error('Missing '+key+' target: '+p[key]);"
scripts.validate: npm run validate:package && npm run validate:json && npm run validate:syntax && npm run validate:files && npm run validate:config
scripts.verify:build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const files=['index.html','style.css','script.js','manifest.json','service-worker.js','robots.txt','sitemap.xml','ads.txt','seo.txt','aeo.txt','security.txt']; for(const file of files){const target='dist/'+file; if(!fs.existsSync(target)||fs.statSync(target).size===0) throw new Error('Missing or empty build artifact: '+target); if(!fs.readFileSync(file).equals(fs.readFileSync(target))) throw new Error('Build artifact differs from source: '+target);}"
scripts.ci:check: npm run validate && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
